identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-20] Remediate review findings and run release preflight

values.summary: Prepare now; execute only after #5357 is live-merged and ancestral.

steps.action: Refresh live issue #5363, current origin/main, and v0.91.8 release-tail sequence before execution.
Verify WP-19 #5357 live merge state and prove the observed merge SHA is ancestral to the exact #5363 execution base.
Verify completed child evidence for #5548 and #5558 against current origin/main ancestry instead of treating either child as open implementation.

unsupported release claims could be hidden in checklist prose
